preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array a is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the array a is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or d_i >= 0 for d_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 if a_i % 2 == a_j % 2 else d_i >= 0 for i, d_i in enumerate(output) for j, a_j in enumerate(a))
postconditions.description: If a_i and a_j have the same parity, d_i is -1; otherwise, d_i is a non-negative integer.
